title: Super Micro adds to 2024 gains as BofA sees AI driving 'meaningful shift' in servers - Seeking Alpha
snippet: More Trending News Toast stock slides amid report company will lay off 550 employees Energy Transfer, Williams in conference call clash over gas pipeline dispute Twilio slumps 15% as analysts debate operational review of segment business Elon Musk discloses up to 20.5% stake in Tesla Coca-Cola raises dividend by 5.4% to $0.485 About SMCI Stock Related Stocks Trending Analysis Trending News Super Micro adds to 2024 gains as BofA sees AI driving 'meaningful shift' in servers JHVEPhoto Super Micro Computer (NASDAQ:SMCI) added to its yearly gains on Thursday as Bank of America initiated coverage on the artificial intelligence-focused server company and said AI is driving a "meaningful shift" in the market.  It has also used its prowess to build server technology from the ground up and design its own chassis, motherboard and other components, allowing it to provide the highest performing customized offerings for its customers, providing it with a "key competitive advantage," the analysts said.  The market for AI servers is believed to grow at a 50% annual clip over the next three years, well above the 5.5% that the traditional server market has grown over the past 17 years, the investment firm said. And with Super Micro seen as a leader in the space, its revenue is poised to grow even faster and take market share as a result.
